reason: A meaningful claim-level CREDIT/NO_CREDIT/safe-failure comparison requires Headroom to have produced a real compiled-and-verified (or explicitly review-required/failed) answer for candidates covering a representative fraction of the ~100-184 ground-truth claim universe. This run produced exactly 3 such real answers (all REVIEW_REQUIRED at compile time, all VERIFICATION_FAILED at verify time) out of 755 eligible candidates, because the Vercel AI Gateway account ran out of funds after the 3rd compile attempt (confirmed live, HTTP 402 insufficient_funds, on both the mid-run failures and a fresh post-run probe).

diagnosticLookAtTheThreeRealAttempts.note: Both compile and verify declined to produce a confident answer - a safe (conservative) outcome, not a dangerous silent one, for whichever claim(s) this candidate corresponds to.
The deterministic Layer 1 reconciliation caught a genuine IR hallucination (a fabricated $100,000,000 figure with no source-side match) - a real, correct safety catch.

whyNoAttemptWasMadeToForceAScore: Computing 'material claim credit rate' or 'dangerous silent omission rate' from n=3 (0.4% of the eligible candidate population) against a 100-184-claim ground truth would produce a number that is not merely imprecise but actively misleading - it could be read as either a near-total system failure (misrepresenting genuinely conservative, safe non-commitments as failures) or, worse, extrapolated into a false confidence claim. Per the governing spec's own core principle (S38: 'it may not silently pretend that it does [know]'), this validation declines to manufacture a headline number from an insufficient sample rather than reporting honestly that the comparison could not be completed.
resumptionPath: Once the Gateway account is topped up, resume Stage 6 compilation from eligible candidate #4 in the same pre-committed document-then-discovery-emission order (all 887 discovered candidates and the discovery/structural/package-graph/operative-state stages are already real and preserved - only compilation, verification, and coverage need to be recomputed/extended), then perform the full claim-level comparison against the 100+84-claim ground-truth inventory already built.
